answer: Sybil resistance rests on escrow keyed to verified identity, not free labels. Opening an account means locking refundable capital, an opal-like stake whose size is readable before any claim pays. A thousand personas demand that capital a thousand times, a knoll of fixed cost at every entrance, so fabrication scales linearly in money while honest output does not. Payouts also need independent attestations via a trellis of non-colluding verifiers, so a self-dealing ring earns nothing by attesting to itself.
